canonicalSerialization: JSON.stringify(parsedObject); only 46 approved glyphs removed from records, recipes or characters, retaining array order and all other fields

runtimeCoverageDefinition: Import HANJA_STROKES and run hanjaStrokeData against every current catalog record; a glyph counts only when the runtime path count matches its catalog stroke count. This is local runtime coverage, not a deployed site observation.
